title: A living world
text:
Heroes move as one, the wilds have their own music, and there is more to find on the road.

🔧 Hero models no longer smear or trail when they move. Every hero's skin was re-weighted so joints bend smoothly instead of tearing, cutting stretched surface by 70 to 85 percent while running, fighting and jumping
🔧 Your hero's body, legs and facing now follow your movement without delay. Stacked smoothing that made limbs and turns lag behind has been removed
• A new animation state machine: running uses a natural stride with no back-kick, jumps push off, tuck and reach for the landing, attacks on the move keep your stride, and every change of state (landing, sitting, mounting, swimming) blends smoothly
✨ Idle and ready stances: stand still for a while and your hero looks around, rolls their shoulders, checks their weapon or stretches. In combat the ready stance stays light on its feet
✨ Zone music: every wild zone has its own original theme that fades in as you travel, including Amberfield Morning, Under the Thornwood, Gloamfen Mists, Stones of Vael, Embers Rising, Frostpeak Silence, the Stormwake Shanty, Mirrowmere Stillness and The Scorched Reach. Hearthmere and Brinehaven keep their tavern music
✨ Wayside campfires in every zone: sit by one for a few seconds to be Warmed by the Fire (+5% maximum health for 20 minutes)
✨ Lore stones: 18 carved stones tell Emberfall's history, with experience the first time you read each one and two new achievements
✨ Forgotten satchels hide in every zone: coin and often a herb or ore, once a day for each character
✨ Toss a gold coin into the fountains of Hearthmere or Brinehaven for a fortune
✨ The world feels alive: butterflies by day, fireflies at night, falling leaves in Thornwood, embers in the Caldera and the Reach, snow on Frostpeak, gulls over the coast and fish leaping in the lakes. Townsfolk chat as you pass, and after dark some head home while the rest carry lanterns
✨ Dungeon and raid approaches: the Sunken Vault, Cinderhold and Hollowdeep Crypt now each open from their own named court (the Drowned Steps, the Ember Gate and Hollowdeep Barrow), with braziers, banners, no roaming monsters and dungeon music
• Piggy Smallz now costs 1,500 gold. Hilde's paddock shows off Piggy Smallz and the Celestial Steed
✨ Five new achievements: Curious Mind, Loremaster, Finders Keepers, Fireside Tales and Wishful Thinking
